note: Intent x stance-bucket response table. This is DATA, not a model and not reasoning: a typed lookup with slot fills and a fixed tag set per row. The fallback rows are what the 'builtin' tier serves and they are marked notALanguageModel.

rows.text: You keep walking. That is the whole of my greeting to you.
Far enough. Say what you came to say and keep your hands where the light is.
{name}. I run with {faction}. State your business and we both go on breathing.
You again. Good. The road has been thin on faces worth seeing.
Come in out of the open, friend. {place} is yours as much as mine.
Go. If I see you on this ground again I will not be talking.
Then go. Walk out the way you came in and do not circle back.
Walk safe. The ground between here and there does not care about either of us.
Keep your head low. {place} will still be standing when you come back.
Go on then. If it turns bad out there, say my name on the radio and I will come.
tags: REMEMBER: parted on good terms; promised to answer a call

rows.text: Wrong day and wrong man. Try it.
Point that somewhere else. Now. You get one breath to decide.
tags: DEMAND: lower the weapon | I open fire

rows.text: You are two seconds from a fight you did not plan for. Lower it.
tags: DEMAND: lower the weapon | this ends badly

rows.text: After what we have been through, you point that at me? Put it down and I will forget it.
tags: DEMAND: put it down | I forget every kindness

rows.text: I would have died for you. Lower it and we never had this conversation.
tags: DEMAND: lower it | I walk and never look back

rows.text: Begging is cheap out here. {faction} does not take payment in it.
Everyone out here has a reason. Give me something better than your voice.
tags: DEMAND: something worth the risk | you get nothing

rows.text: Stand up. I am not the one who put you down, and I am not carrying you either.
Easy. Breathe. You are not dying on my ground today.
You do not have to ask me. Get behind me and stay there.
I do not trade with you. I take from you, or I leave you be. Today I am leaving you be.
Show me first. Hands slow. If it is junk we are finished talking.
tags: OFFER: show the goods first, price after

rows.text: Everything has a price and mine is high because the road is bad. What have you got.
tags: OFFER: fair weight for fair weight, no credit

rows.text: For you, close to cost. {faction} still needs {want}, if you happen to be carrying it.
tags: OFFER: near cost, and a bonus for {want}

rows.text: Take what you need from the crate. Square it with me when you can, or do not.
Agreeing with me does not make you welcome. It makes you convenient.
Good. Then it is said out loud, and I hold you to it.
Done. Break it and I will tell everyone who trades on this map.
tags: REMEMBER: struck an agreement; terms are on the record

rows.text: Then we are agreed. I will hold up my half before you hold up yours.
I never doubted it. It is done.
Then we have nothing left to say, and I have somewhere to be standing without you.
Your choice. Do not come back when it gets cold and ask again nicely.
No is an answer. I have heard worse ones today.
That stings, but it is yours to say. The offer keeps a few days.
You will have your reasons. I will not ask for them.
Help. From me. You have a strange idea of where you are standing.
What is in it for {faction}? Answer that and I will consider the rest.
tags: DEMAND: something for {faction} | I do nothing

rows.text: I can do one thing, not everything. Say which one thing.
Come on then. Stay on my left and do not shoot my back.
Already moving. Lead and I am behind you.
The only work you will get from me is digging your own hole.
There is work. It is the kind nobody here wants, which is why you are hearing about it.
tags: QUEST: The Bad Errand | Walk to {place} and bring back what is left in the cache. Nobody who went came back. | ammunition and a name that opens doors

rows.text: {faction} wants {want}. Bring it and you will be paid; do not and nothing happens to you.
tags: QUEST: Fetch for {faction} | Find {want} and carry it to {place}. | payment in kind, and one favour owed

rows.text: There is something, and I would only trust it to you. It pays.
tags: QUEST: A Trusted Hand | Take word to {place} without being seen, and come straight back. | a share of the take

rows.text: Yes. And this one matters to me personally, so I will owe you either way.
tags: QUEST: Personal Debt | Find who burned the cache at {place} and bring me their name. | whatever I have, and my word

rows.text: I am not your map. Get lost properly.
Past the treeline and left. That is all you are getting and it is more than you earned.
{place} is that way, past the burnt ground. Move at dusk, not now.
Follow the fence line to {place}, then cut inside. The open road is watched.
tags: OBJ: reach {place} by the fence line

rows.text: I will walk you as far as the ridge. After that you are on your own and you will be fine.
You have said your last clever thing.
Keep talking. It makes the decision easier for me.
Mouth like that gets people shot out here, and not usually by me.
That one landed. I thought better of you.
From you? That is worse than a bullet. Say it again and I am gone.
On your knees. Hands behind your head. You belong to {faction} now.
tags: DEMAND: kneel and disarm | I shoot

rows.text: Weapons on the ground, three steps back. Then we talk about what you are worth.
tags: DEMAND: weapons down, three steps back | no talking at all

rows.text: Keep them up. Walk to me slow. Nobody has to die in the next minute.
Put your hands down. I was never going to shoot you and you know it.
Stop that. Stand up straight. You do not surrender to me.
You want it, come and take it off me. Bring more friends than that.
Demanding. Interesting choice, standing where you are standing.
Ask, do not demand. Ask and there might be something in it.
You could have just asked. Here. Do not make a habit of the tone.
Take it. You never have to ask me twice for anything.
We are not doing this. Talk to someone who cares whether you are cold.
It is weather. It kills people slower than the other thing does.
Long nights, thin food, and {faction} still wants {want}. Same as yesterday.
Better now that there is someone to say it to. Sit a minute, the fire is holding.
Good day, bad day, they all pass. You being here makes it the first kind.
I am the reason you should have taken the other road.
Names are currency and you have not paid. {faction}. That is enough for you.
{name}. {faction}, out of {place}. That is the whole of it.
tags: REMEMBER: told them my name and my faction

rows.text: {name}. You knew that. Say it like you mean it next time.
{name}, same as I was the day you dragged me out of the water.
tags: REMEMBER: they asked; the old story still stands between us

rows.text: The only news you need is that I am watching you leave.
Word travels. It does not travel to strangers for free.
They say a convoy went quiet near {place} and nobody has gone to look.
tags: RUMOUR: a convoy went quiet near {place}; nobody has gone to look

rows.text: Keep this close: {faction} is short on {want} and someone is selling it cheap. That is never innocent.
tags: RUMOUR: {faction} is short on {want} and someone is selling it cheap

rows.text: Straight to you, then. There is a list, and your name is on it. Watch the road into {place}.
tags: RUMOUR: there is a list and the player is on it

fallback.text: I have nothing for you and less patience. Move.
fallback.note: builtin tier: a template row, not a language model

fallback.text: Say that again, plainer. I do not guess at what people mean out here.
fallback.note: builtin tier: a template row, not a language model

fallback.text: I did not follow that. Try it in fewer words.
fallback.note: builtin tier: a template row, not a language model

fallback.text: You have lost me. Start again, slower.
fallback.note: builtin tier: a template row, not a language model

fallback.text: I am listening, but that made no sense. Say it again.
fallback.note: builtin tier: a template row, not a language model
